lead: Vijay Mallya is an Indian entrepreneur, born on 18 December 1955 in Kolkata.
As of 2026, he is 70 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and has been recognised with the Officer of the Legion of Honour.
This profile collects the Vijay facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
